title: Use a Quality Release Agent
text: Use a Quality Release Agent. My first impresson of the Gigilli Coaster Resin Mold set is that it's nice to have some molds that make coasters that don't look like big hockey pucks. I was concerned about the thin silicone, so I made some paperboard supports for pouring and casting along with a tried-and-true release agent. Things turned out fine for me, as I took and extra precaution and left the cured resin coasters and container in warm soapy water before I attempted to demold. Although it took some extra effort, I'm satisfied with the results. I cannot highly recommend this set, nor would I discourage anyone else from trying them. This takes a little extra effort and patience to use, so that may or may not be worth it to you. I don't mind the extra work as it builds on my skills. Overall, these are not a great value, but do the job and they look nice when finished well. Thanks for reading my review. I hope my experience is helpful to you and you kindly will click the button below.
